characters.name: Cain
clues: I was the first child ever born to two people.
I was jealous when God favored my brother's offering over mine.
I killed my brother Abel out of anger.

characters.name: Abel
clues: I kept flocks of sheep.
God favored my offering over my brother's.
I was murdered by my own brother.

characters.name: Lot
clues: I was Abraham's nephew.
I chose to live near a wicked city.
My wife looked back and turned into a pillar of salt.

characters.name: Hagar
clues: I was an Egyptian servant.
I bore Abraham a son when his wife could not.
God provided a well for me and my son in the wilderness.

characters.name: Rebekah
clues: I drew water for a stranger's camels at a well.
I became Isaac's wife.
I helped my son Jacob receive his father's blessing instead of his brother.

characters.name: Esau
clues: I was born first, covered in red hair.
I sold my birthright for a bowl of stew.
My brother tricked me out of our father's blessing.

characters.name: Rachel
clues: I was a shepherdess when I met my future husband at a well.
My father tricked my husband into marrying my sister first.
I died giving birth to my youngest son, Benjamin.

characters.name: Leah
clues: I was the older of two sisters.
My father deceived my husband into marrying me first.
I gave birth to Judah, from whose line the promised King would come.

characters.name: Laban
clues: I was Rebekah's brother.
I tricked my nephew into marrying my older daughter first.
I was the father of Rachel and Leah.

characters.name: Potiphar
clues: I was an Egyptian official.
I bought a Hebrew slave to serve in my house.
My wife falsely accused my faithful servant, so I had him imprisoned.

characters.name: Judah
clues: I was one of twelve brothers.
I suggested selling our brother instead of killing him.
My family's line would one day produce the promised King.

characters.name: Benjamin
clues: I was the youngest of twelve brothers.
My mother died giving birth to me.
My brother hid a silver cup in my sack to test our family.

characters.name: Zipporah
clues: I was a shepherdess from Midian.
I became Moses' wife.
My father was the priest of Midian.

characters.name: Eleazar
clues: I was one of Aaron's sons.
I became high priest after my father died.
I helped Moses take a census of Israel.

characters.name: Ithamar
clues: I was one of Aaron's sons.
My older brothers died for offering strange fire.
I oversaw the work of the Levites in the tabernacle.

characters.name: Hur
clues: I helped hold up Moses' hands during a crucial battle.
I worked alongside Aaron.
I helped lead Israel while Moses was up on Mount Sinai.

characters.name: Bezaleel
clues: I was filled with the Spirit of God for skilled craftsmanship.
I was chosen to build the tabernacle's furnishings.
I worked with gold, silver, and bronze for God's house.

characters.name: Nadab
clues: I was one of Aaron's sons.
I served as a priest alongside my brothers.
I offered strange fire before the LORD and was consumed by fire.

characters.name: Abihu
clues: I was one of Aaron's sons.
I served as a priest alongside my brothers.
I died alongside my brother for disobedient worship.

characters.name: Dathan
clues: I joined a rebellion against Moses' leadership.
I complained about being led out of Egypt.
The earth opened up and swallowed me and my family.

characters.name: Balak
clues: I was a king who feared the Israelites.
I hired a prophet to curse God's people.
My plan failed when the prophet blessed Israel instead.

characters.name: Og
clues: I was a giant king of Bashan.
I had an iron bed of enormous size.
Israel defeated me and took my land east of the Jordan.

characters.name: Absalom
clues: I was one of King David's sons.
I rebelled against my own father.
My long hair caught in a tree branch, leading to my death.

characters.name: Bathsheba
clues: A king saw me bathing and desired me.
My first husband was killed in battle by the king's order.
My son Solomon became the wisest king of Israel.

characters.name: Joab
clues: I commanded King David's army.
I helped capture the city of Jerusalem.
I killed Absalom against the king's direct orders.

characters.name: Jezebel
clues: I was a foreign princess who became queen of Israel.
I promoted the worship of a false god named Baal.
I was thrown from a window and my body was eaten by dogs.

characters.name: Mordecai
clues: I raised my orphaned cousin as my own daughter.
I uncovered a plot to assassinate the king.
I was honored by the king instead of the man who plotted my death.

characters.name: Joel
clues: I was a prophet who described a devastating locust plague.
I prophesied about God pouring out His Spirit on all people.
The apostle Peter quoted my words on the day of Pentecost.

characters.name: Obadiah
clues: I wrote the shortest book in the Old Testament.
My entire message was a judgment against one nation.
I prophesied against Edom, the descendants of Esau.

characters.name: Nahum
clues: I prophesied about the fall of a great and wicked city.
My message came after another prophet's earlier warning to that same city.
I announced judgment against Nineveh.

characters.name: Habakkuk
clues: I questioned God about why evil seemed to go unpunished.
God answered that He was raising up the Chaldeans to bring judgment.
I wrote that the just shall live by faith.

characters.name: Zephaniah
clues: I was a descendant of King Hezekiah.
I prophesied during King Josiah's reign.
I spoke of the great and terrible day of the LORD.

characters.name: Haggai
clues: I encouraged the exiles to rebuild God's house.
I prophesied to Zerubbabel and Joshua the high priest.
My short book helped restart work on the second temple.

characters.name: Huldah
clues: I was a prophetess living in Jerusalem.
King Josiah's officials came to me to inquire of the LORD.
I confirmed that the newly found Book of the Law was true.

characters.name: Joseph the Carpenter
clues: I was a humble, hardworking tradesman from the town of Nazareth.
An angel told me in a dream not to fear taking my betrothed as my wife.
I raised Jesus as my own son.

characters.name: Elizabeth
clues: I was barren for many years.
My relative visited me while both of us were expecting sons.
I gave birth to John the Baptist in my old age.

characters.name: Herod the Great
clues: I was king when Jesus was born.
Wise men came to my palace asking about a newborn king.
I ordered the deaths of infant boys in Bethlehem.

characters.name: Herod Antipas
clues: I ruled over Galilee during Jesus' ministry.
I had John the Baptist beheaded.
Pilate sent Jesus to me before His crucifixion.

characters.name: Caiaphas
clues: I was the high priest the year Jesus was crucified.
I said it was better for one man to die for the people.
I presided over Jesus' trial before the Jewish council.

characters.name: Simon of Cyrene
clues: I was a traveler from North Africa.
Roman soldiers forced me into an unexpected task.
I carried Jesus' cross on the way to Golgotha.

characters.name: Bartimaeus
clues: I was a blind beggar sitting by the road.
I called out loudly even when the crowd told me to be quiet.
Jesus healed my sight because of my faith.

characters.name: Jairus
clues: I was a ruler of the synagogue.
I begged Jesus to come heal my dying daughter.
Jesus raised my daughter from the dead.

characters.name: Anna
clues: I was a very old prophetess.
I worshiped in the temple night and day.
I recognized the infant Jesus as the promised redeemer.

characters.name: The Samaritan Woman
clues: I met a Jewish stranger at a well in the heat of the day.
I had been married five times.
Jesus told me about living water, and I told my whole town about Him.

characters.name: Simon the Zealot
clues: I was one of the twelve apostles.
I belonged to a group known for zealous devotion to Jewish law.
Little else is recorded of me beyond my name among the twelve.

characters.name: Matthias
clues: I was chosen by casting lots.
I replaced a disciple who had betrayed Jesus.
I became the twelfth apostle after the resurrection.

characters.name: Stephen
clues: I was one of the first seven deacons chosen to serve.
I gave a bold speech before the Jewish council.
I became the first Christian martyr, stoned to death.

characters.name: Apollos
clues: I was an eloquent speaker from Alexandria.
I taught boldly but needed correcting on some doctrine.
A husband and wife explained the way of God to me more accurately.

characters.name: Titus
clues: I was a Gentile companion of Paul.
Paul sent me to organize the church on the island of Crete.
Paul wrote me a letter about sound doctrine and godly living.

characters.name: Priscilla
clues: I worked as a tentmaker alongside my husband.
We hosted a church in our home.
My husband and I explained the way of God more accurately to a gifted preacher named Apollos.
